Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/fuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-request_fuzzer-5717480481226752').read_bytes()
buflen=len(b)
p=b.find(b'\r')+2 # buffer+1 from endline+1
n=0; starts=[]
while n<64 and buflen>p:
    j=b.find(b'\r',p)
    if j<0: break
    if p==j:
        print('blank at',j,'bytes',b[j:j+2])
        # switch would read 2 from j; if CRLF helper next; process
        break
    starts.append((n,p,j,b[p:j][:10],b[j:j+3]))
    n+=2; p=j+2
else:
    print('loop exit n',n,'p',p,'buflen>p',buflen>p)
print('n',n,'p',p,'numhdr',len(starts))
for s in starts: print(s)
PY
